title: My phone showed me a memory from tomorrow 🗓️
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 3:33 in the morning my phone showed me a memory from tomorrow.

scenes.narration: At 3:33 in the morning my phone showed me a memory from tomorrow.
It was the usual notification. On this day. But the date underneath was tomorrow's. And the photo was of my own front door.
The door was open. The hallway light was on. And in the doorway, a shape stood, smiling the way I do in photos, when I am pretending to be fine.
I swiped to the next one. Same doorway. Closer. The shape was holding my keys.
There were forty photos. Tomorrow evening, going into the night. Each frame, the shape was a little more like me.
The last photo was taken from inside my bedroom, from the exact place I was sitting right now. The time said, 3:34.
My phone buzzed. A new memory. Taken one minute ago. It showed me, from behind. Sitting on the bed, holding the phone. And a hand, resting gently, on my shoulder.
So tell me. Do you look at your shoulder, or keep scrolling?
